player_upgrade.dtp.module_slots.desc: +1 personal module slot per level. Equip modules in the Modules tab.

player_upgrade.dtp.barrier.desc.2: Module: After a hit, 4 shield hearts for 10 s. Cooldown 30 s.

player_upgrade.dtp.updraft.desc: Module: Rockets used while gliding are kept with a 50% chance.
player_upgrade.dtp.dash.desc: Skill: A quick leap in the direction you look. Cooldown 4 s.
player_upgrade.dtp.double_jump.desc: Skill: A second jump in mid-air (jump key or skill key). Cooldown 2 s.

player_upgrade.dtp.fishing_net.desc: Skill: Catches every cod, salmon, tropical fish and pufferfish in the water within 3 blocks; the catch goes straight into your inventory. Cooldown 5 s.
player_upgrade.dtp.contract_capacity.des: Accept one more contract at the same time.
player_upgrade.dtp.quick_delivery.desc: Higher time bonus (+30% instead of +20%). In return, after the bonus window the contract loses 20% instead of 10% per day.
player_upgrade.dtp.contract_clock.desc: The clock's tooltip shows your accepted contracts with progress, value and time until the next drop. Sneak + right-click a market scale to bind the clock to its item; it then also shows that item's market price.
player_upgrade.dtp.remote_delivery.desc: Sneak + right-click with the clock to deliver matching items from your inventory to your contracts, anywhere in the territory. The reward goes into your inventory.
player_upgrade.dtp.looting_bonus.desc: Swords and spears in your main hand count one more level of Looting.
player_upgrade.dtp.fortune_bonus.desc: Tools in your hand count one more level of Fortune.
player_upgrade.dtp.luck_of_the_sea_bonus: Your fishing rod counts one more level of Luck of the Sea — even beyond the maximum.
player_upgrade.dtp.lure_bonus.desc: Your fishing rod counts one more level of Lure — even beyond the maximum.
player_upgrade.dtp.tree_felling.desc: Sneak while chopping with an axe to fell the whole tree (8 / 16 / 32 / 64 logs). Logs go straight to your inventory, then +1 block pickup range for 5 s.
player_upgrade.dtp.vein_mining.desc: Sneak while mining with a pickaxe to mine the whole vein (8 / 16 blocks). Drops go straight to your inventory.
upgrade.dtp.effect_agriculture.desc: Crops grow faster, farmland can't be trampled, composters fill more often.
upgrade.dtp.effect_stablemaster.desc: Animals breed again sooner, better foals. Mounts are 20% faster, take no fall damage and stay put for 1 minute after you dismount. 30% faster on paths, on foot and in the saddle.
upgrade.dtp.effect_beekeeping.desc: More honey and bigger hive harvests; bees grow plants and don't sting.
upgrade.dtp.effect_builder.desc: +2 blocks reach. Blocks you placed can be broken instantly for 10 s and go back into your inventory.
upgrade.dtp.effect_quiet_nights.desc: No phantoms for players in range — and so no phantom membranes either.
upgrade.dtp.effect_expedition.desc: Potions last twice as long and are kept with a 25% chance; food saturates 50% more.
upgrade.dtp.border.desc: Extends the territory and world border by one step. The last level removes the border.
upgrade.dtp.enderman_griefing.desc: Endermen no longer carry blocks away.
upgrade.dtp.furnace_speed.desc.1: Furnaces in the beacon area and near relay beacons work 25% faster.
upgrade.dtp.furnace_speed.desc.2: Furnaces in the beacon area and near relay beacons work 50% faster.
upgrade.dtp.mending_aura.desc: Slowly repairs items in your inventory anywhere in the beacon area and near relay beacons (level I: 1, level II: 2 durability every 10 seconds).
upgrade.dtp.anvil_cap.desc: Anvil work costs at most 39 levels.
upgrade.dtp.market_info.desc: Shows percentage and trend arrow of prices at the market stall.
upgrade.dtp.effect_jump_boost.desc: Beacon effect Jump Boost I in range. Uses an effect slot.
upgrade.dtp.effect_night_vision.desc: Beacon effect Night Vision in range. Uses an effect slot.
upgrade.dtp.effect_water_breathing.desc: Beacon effect Water Breathing in range. Uses an effect slot.
upgrade.dtp.effect_resistance.desc: Beacon effect Resistance I in range. Uses an effect slot.

upgrade.dtp.contract_tier.desc.2: Contracts of tier 2 appear on the board. Needs contracts completed server-wide.
upgrade.dtp.contract_tier.desc.3: Contracts of tier 3 appear on the board. Needs contracts completed server-wide.
upgrade.dtp.contract_tier.desc.4: Contracts of tier 4 appear on the board. Needs contracts completed server-wide.

upgrade.dtp.effect_slots.desc.2: 2 effect slots on the beacon. Switch effects on in the Effects tab.
upgrade.dtp.effect_slots.desc.3: 3 effect slots on the beacon. Switch effects on in the Effects tab.
upgrade.dtp.price_stability.desc.1: Prices drop more slowly when selling: 10% more sales until the price halves.
upgrade.dtp.price_stability.desc.2: Prices drop more slowly when selling: 20% more sales until the price halves.
upgrade.dtp.contract_quality.desc.1: More higher-tier contracts on the board: +5 percentage points roll chance for tiers 2 to 4.
upgrade.dtp.contract_quality.desc.2: More higher-tier contracts on the board: +10 percentage points roll chance for tiers 2 to 4.
